title: Set your language and time zone

steps.say: Tap **Localisation** to choose the language the dashboard speaks to you in, and the time zone your dates and times are read against.

Pick your interface language and time zone, then tap **Save changes**. This is remembered on the device you set it on — teachers and students each choose their own, so it doesn't change what anybody else sees.
steps.terminal: That's the whole thing — one language, one time zone, always changeable, always in the same place.
